stories.title: Christa Pike ha ripreso conoscenza e parla

en.title: Christa Pike has regained consciousness and is speaking
en.summary: A death row inmate in the United States has regained consciousness and is able to speak after surviving execution. Her lawyers describe the case as unprecedented.

stories.title: Christa Pike, sopravvissuta a due iniezioni letali negli Usa, è cosciente e parla

en.title: Christa Pike, survived two lethal injections in the US, is conscious and speaking
en.summary: A death-sentenced woman has regained consciousness and regained the ability to speak after surviving execution. Her legal team characterizes the situation as without precedent.

stories.title: Tennessee, Christa Pike è cosciente e parla dopo l’esecuzione fallita con due iniezioni “letali”

en.title: Tennessee, Christa Pike is conscious and speaking after failed execution with two "lethal" injections
en.summary: An inmate survived two doses of pentobarbital and remains hospitalized. Her attorneys indicate her prognosis remains uncertain and anticipate an extended recovery period.

stories.title: Malagò commissario della Figc, nuove elezioni forse già il 14 dicembre

en.title: Malagò commissioner of the Italian Football Federation, new elections possibly on December 14
en.summary: Italian sports authority bodies unanimously decided to appoint a commissioner to lead the national football federation. New elections may take place in mid-December.

stories.title: Garlasco, Sempio: "Non vivo più, sono sempre dall'avvocato o chiuso in casa"

en.title: Garlasco, Sempio: "I no longer live, I'm always at the lawyer's or shut in at home"
en.summary: The sole suspect in a new investigation into a 2007 murder case spoke on a television program, describing his difficult living situation.

stories.title: Andrea Sempio: “Chiuso in casa, ho paura. La macchia di assassino che se l’è cavata non si leva mai”

en.title: Andrea Sempio: "Shut in at home, I'm afraid. The mark of a murderer who got away with it never goes away"
en.summary: A suspect in an investigation discussed his fears and concerns on television, maintaining his innocence while commenting on a related conviction.

stories.title: Francia in piazza: proteste per la scuola e scontri tra cortei e polizia

en.title: France in the streets: protests over schools and clashes between demonstrators and police
en.summary: Students, teachers, and unions organized demonstrations supporting public education, which later turned violent with confrontations between protesters and law enforcement.

stories.title: Trump, 'Islam e immigrazione responsabili di quanto accade in Francia'

en.title: Trump, 'Islam and immigration responsible for what is happening in France'
en.summary: A political figure made statements attributing developments in France to issues related to Islam and immigration rather than education policy.

stories.title: Scontri al corteo degli studenti, barricate e lacrimogeni a Strasburgo

en.title: Clashes at student protest, barricades and tear gas in Strasbourg
en.summary: Tensions erupted in the university area following a lengthy demonstration that included members of the European Parliament.

stories.title: Garlasco, Sempio: “Non vivo più, la macchia dell’assassino non te la levi. Stasi? Condanna giusta”

en.title: Garlasco, Sempio: "I no longer live, the stain of murderer never leaves you. Stasi? Just conviction"
en.summary: A suspect in the Chiara Poggi murder case appeared on television discussing his situation, addressing evidence related to a bloodstained footprint and denying interest in the victim.

stories.title: Francia, studenti in piazza: fermate 488 persone, licei chiusi, scontri a Parigi. Macron convoca il governo, Trump accusa l’Islam

en.title: France, students in streets: 488 arrested, schools closed, clashes in Paris. Macron convenes government, Trump accuses Islam
en.summary: Police clashed with demonstrators across multiple French cities, resulting in arrests and school closures, while political figures offered differing interpretations of the violence.

stories.title: Francia, gli studenti tornano in piazza: scontri a Parigi e Strasburgo. Trump: “Colpa dell’Islam”

en.title: France, students return to streets: clashes in Paris and Strasbourg. Trump: "Islam's fault"
en.summary: Further student demonstrations took place following violent incidents from the previous weekend, with high school classes suspended in some areas for internal civic activities.

stories.title: Uranio, Mike Pompeo nominato presidente di Reveille Resources

en.title: Uranium, Mike Pompeo appointed president of Reveille Resources
en.summary: Mike Pompeo has been appointed president of Reveille Resources, an exploration and development company focused on historic uranium deposits in Italy, including sites at Novazza and Val Vedello.

stories.title: Il Salone di Genova si chiude con oltre 138mila visitatori

en.title: Genoa Boat Show closes with over 138,000 visitors
en.summary: The 66th edition of the Genoa International Boat Show concluded with visitor numbers exceeding 138,000, representing an 11.2 percent increase compared to the previous year's event.

stories.title: Stellantis, cresce la produzione in Italia ma Mirafiori frena e Cassino è in negativo

en.title: Stellantis, production grows in Italy but Mirafiori slows and Cassino is negative
en.summary: Stellantis production in Italy increased 28.3% in the third quarter compared to 2025, with automobile production up 36.7%. Forecasts for 2026 project 450,000 vehicles, though some plants including Mirafiori and Cassino are experiencing declines.

stories.title: Maccaferri (Ambienta) acquisisce Iterchimica e Surface Tech

en.title: Maccaferri (Ambienta) acquires Iterchimica and Surface Tech
en.summary: Ambienta, a sustainability-focused investment company founded by Nino Tronchetti Provera, has announced that its platform company Officine Maccaferri is acquiring Iterchimica and Surface Tech.

stories.title: Nucleare, Mimit e Mase aprono la corsa delle imprese all’Ipcei: proposte entro il 3 dicembre

en.title: Nuclear, Mimit and Mase open the race for companies in the Ipcei: proposals by December 3
en.summary: The Italian government has launched an industrial initiative for nuclear energy development, inviting company proposals by December 3, following the Senate's approval of nuclear legislation.
